response.diary: Fri Jan 9: Still sick with fever, cough and aches. Masked for MATH, quick dinner, otherwise resting at home and skipping the hangouts. Worried it spread from Stern.

messages.text: Thanks for the heads up everyone. I'm sick with fever and cough so I'm skipping the lounge tonight too. Feel better and stay well!

response.thoughts: I woke up with fever, chills, cough and aches. I already told the group, so I'll keep it low-key. I'm sick and worried, but I usually push through, so I'll go to MATH in a mask, then come straight home. I'll skip dinner out and the hangouts, and maybe grab food quickly or have it brought. I should also think about a Vaden visit, but I'll just rest and see how I feel.
